scope: Opt-in Linux x86_64 Godot native window for the original ARM32 Harmattan UI; offline disposable sessions

historical_private_experiment.code_state: Verified private experiment before public path/CLI cleanup; not a test of the final public integration

provenance.availability: Sanitized summary only; private raw evidence, guest media and binaries are excluded from this repository

runtime.transport: owned private local files; controller-owned QMP stdio; no exposed services

steps: Actual right-edge mouse drag returned Home
Notes Linux -> Linu -> Linux works through visible Maliit
Native Quit closed window after cleanup

same_source_repeat.evidence_limit: Compact repeat summaries retained; full repeat frame telemetry not included in the private source kit

idle_comparison.window: 30 seconds from first capture publication +5 s to +35 s; Home idle; both logs cover the full window
idle_comparison.cpu_normalization: One logical CPU = 100%; cumulative process ticks with window-boundary interpolation
idle_comparison.limit: Capture/transport and frontend callback measurements, not guest FPS, physical scanout or photons

gesture_comparison.limit: Same route with different duration, not identical timed-motion replay; timing starts at the Godot callback, not hardware input; acknowledgement is not application acceptance

startup.limit: First optimized run partly overlapped host tests; repeat did not. Frontend contention and readiness hash order changed together. Host load, caches and guest readiness vary; these few runs cannot isolate causation or guarantee a fixed speedup. Do not double-count nested spans.

render_consistency.observation: Identical RGB in selected Calculator static controls; no missing glyph observed in native window

godot_checks.scope: Headless isolated synthetic frontend session; native interaction validated separately

historical_private_experiment.older_counts: Earlier 417-test aggregate and 27 focused tests predate startup-heartbeat correction; neither is final optimization evidence

public_integration.status: Implementation source verified by independent review and Linux/macOS/Godot CI; guest/native rerun limits remain below

host_suite.reason: Nine LeakSanitizer/ptrace SSI failures; four prohibited AF_UNIX errors; one missing-clang error. None is counted as a pass.

godot_checks.scope: Isolated headless source frontend including consecutive typing, explicit cancellation, lifecycle and protocol errors

publication_check.shell_syntax: passed for every tracked shell script

public_integration.guest_blocker: Prepared guest inputs are unavailable in the publication environment; full guest/native flow was not rerun after path/CLI cleanup
public_integration.note: Final local source checks and CI are separate from the historical guest experiment. Review corrections include ordered key release versus explicit cancellation.

default_report_compatibility.comparison: Default macOS reporter output byte-for-byte equal to baseline; Linux readiness-first polling is enabled only by N00_UI_POLL_READINESS_FIRST=1
default_report_compatibility.scope: Report-output compatibility only; not a macOS runtime regression

ci.initial_failure: The first macOS run exposed a test-only assumption that /proc exists. A deterministic proc-stat/sysconf fixture fixed the test and checks exact CPU/RSS values; production code was unchanged.
ci.scope: Host/source checks and synthetic frontend protocol; no guest media or native desktop interaction in CI. The documentation-only evidence commit is checked separately by the PR workflow.

limitations: No Linux release package or installer validation
No persistent profile; guest writes are discarded after the session
No complete retail startup or cellular/network/browser/audio/camera services
No physical GPU, touch-hardware latency, arbitrary app/layout or long-session acceptance
No full macOS runtime regression rerun
No firmware, kernel, raw/qcow2 disk, rootfs, raw logs, screenshots, fonts, artwork or third-party binaries added
